summary: ADR-0048 accepted 2026-07-26; source files and accepted ADRs remain authoritative; projections/indexes are derived caches; deterministic Locator emits locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence, never synthesized facts; callers reread and hash-check sources; trusted adapters constrain domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence; LLM intent cannot broaden scope; VDD records accept/reject decisions and uncovered required modules block readiness; Quick Dev uses VDD-frozen accepted context; Bootstrap Review freezes accepted context in Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback defaults off and approved Python fallback uses scripts/sc/_llm_backend.py::run_llm_exec; maintenance pins local refs/heads/main without implicit fetch or branch mutation; failures are closed on missing/stale/weak/out-of-policy/hash-drift results; extends ADR-0044, complements but does not replace ADR-0037/0041/0043; excludes phase routes, Hosted E2 changes, live metadata, deployment, acceptance, handoff, release, commit
